detail: One token defined once for both themes. Light was 5.5:1, dark 2.9:1. Fixed with a same-hue dark-mode override at 6.16:1 (cell PR #1, commit 4033dae). The template carries the identical bug (#2d6ea8 = 2.96:1 dark) and every stamped cell inherits it until watermill-cell-template issue #2 is fixed. Nothing in make verify checks contrast, so this is a gate hole: the rule is stated in prose only.
text: The stamped default --brand-primary is 2.9:1 against the dark-mode surface, below the 4.5:1 the file header and CLAUDE.md require in both themes.

detail: Sluice caught it in cell PR #2 (commit 7e8aa9d). Check any prose fence list entry-for-entry against watermill.yaml fence.paths; the contract is the truth and the doc must say which files are fenced and why the others deliberately are not.
text: A doc that misdescribes the fence can disable a repo rule: CLAUDE.md claimed README.md was fenced, which would forbid the docs-in-the-same-change rule stated one bullet above it.

author: human
detail: Fixed in cell PR #3 (commit d484ad3): reject a body that is not an object or whose username/password is not a string with 400 before SQLite or werkzeug see it; 401 stays for wrong credentials in a well-formed body. Millstone's suite tested only well-formed bodies. Any endpoint reachable without a session must be probed with non-object JSON.
text: request.get_json(silent=True) or {} keeps a JSON array, string or number, so payload.get raised and a non-string username reached SQLite: six of ten malformed login bodies returned 500 with a traceback, unauthenticated.

text: Flask sets HttpOnly but never SameSite on the session cookie; with no CSRF token, set SESSION_COOKIE_SAMESITE='Lax' explicitly or another origin can POST to logout with the user's cookie.

detail: Mutation test that found it: make seed_demo_users() UPDATE password_hash unconditionally; the suite passed. Added test_seed_does_not_reset_a_changed_password (cell PR #3). The general rule: for 'idempotent' or 'does not touch X', change X between two calls and assert it survived.
text: An idempotence test must assert the state that must not change: test_seed_is_idempotent stayed green when seeding was made to overwrite every password on start.

text: A fetch wrapper's documented promise (credentials: 'same-origin') had no test: deleting the line left the frontend suite green because it is also the browser default.

author: human
detail: Millstone had a reset branch inside the effect and removed it because react-hooks/set-state-in-effect rejected it, leaving the leak. The shape that satisfies the lint rule: tag fetched state with the session it belongs to and compare during render, not in an effect. Fixed in cell PR #4 (e16a9f9) with two tests that drive a real logout/login through the DOM, one holding the second fetch open to assert on exactly the stale window. The cancellation flag was correct; the bug was the stale render, not a stale write.
text: Per-session React state (modules list, fetch error) was never reset on user change, so logging out and in as another role rendered the previous role's cards, and one failed fetch stuck its error on screen for every later session until reload.

author: human
detail: Fixed in cell PR #4: /api paths return a JSON 404 before the SPA fallback; /, client-side routes and /assets/* still serve. The template's app.py has the same fallback shape. Any test for an unknown API id must assert the status code, not just that the call did not throw.
text: The SPA catch-all served index.html with 200 for unknown /api/* paths, so GET /api/modules/nope was a 200 whose body the client turned into {} and docs/dashboard.md in the same PR called it a 404.

text: list_modules read session['role'] where login_required only proves a session exists, so a role-less session was a 500 instead of an empty list.

text: Mutation-testing every stage of the stamped make verify (guard, build, ruff, eslint, vitest, pytest) proved each one can fail; the deliberately failing typecheck target is correctly outside the gate.

author: human
detail: PRs #1-#4 on zim-dashboard-demo-cell-1b, 2026-08-30. Review-found defects: dark-mode contrast; 500 on malformed login JSON, missing SameSite, two tests that passed broken code; cross-session state leak, SPA fallback swallowing API 404s, 500 on role-less session, stubs with no caller. A green millstone gate is necessary, not sufficient; sluice's independent mutation testing is where the value was.
text: Standing up the cell skeleton took 4 PRs and every one was approve_after_fixes: sluice found real bugs in all three code PRs and a contract contradiction in the docs PR; millstone's own suites passed every one of them.
